report:
Reviewed the complete review_diagnostics claim, all five ordinary implementation entries across review.rs/check.rs/main.rs, and all six ordinary associated tests. No TODO/N/A entries are present. Captured fixture helpers and the workspace Cargo validation test as dependencies.

Requirement mapping: review::validate iterates all current anchors and accumulates per-anchor reasons rather than returning after the first stale record. It identifies missing or unfinished validation, invalid output, concrete requested edits, input/association mismatches and missing evidence. load_saved preserves malformed-record and unsupported-version errors with the directory identity; obsolete records receive explicit retirement/rename guidance. input_errors names implementation or test association/metadata changes separately and names affected fragment paths/selectors for changed or unresolvable context. Thus the diagnostic identifies the anchor and actionable cause, including the affected source/association category rather than a generic failed boolean.

check_reviews translates every ReviewIssue into a Diagnostic at the current anchor's source/span when available, or the validation location otherwise, and retains all rendered errors. It includes review-skill guidance and instructions to delegate/start/record instead of automatically initiating review. CheckReport Display prints every rendered error and ensure_valid returns that same report in CheckError; CheckError Debug forwards Display so both main's Result handler and Cargo Result-test failures show readable diagnostics. main::check uses ensure_valid, and the captured repository validation test uses the identical library call. No checking path invokes review start or record; load_saved only reads under its directory lock. Explicit start/record remain separate operations.

Tests: diagnostics_identify_missing_unfinished_stale_and_requested_edit_reviews drives all four states through the CLI and asserts failed status, anchor and review-skill guidance, plus missing/unfinished labels, stale implementation source path or edit reason. added_or_removed_associations_invalidate_unchanged_saved_fragments verifies adding and removing tests reports test associations while unchanged prior test metadata is retained, then adding implementation evidence reports implementation associations; every case names the anchor and skill. unsupported_versions_and_mismatched_identity_cannot_pass asserts schema/policy and directory/summary identity faults produce anchored, reason-specific library errors with the skill path.

completed_corrupt_records_and_invalid_layout_cannot_pass asserts CLI/library failure and exact relevant diagnostic categories for malformed JSON, blank reviewer/report/edit, unknown output fields, missing summary/input/output and nondirectory entries. Its assertions require the offending anchor/directory, invalid-validation wording, skill and underlying parse/format/filesystem cause. retired_records_fail_even_when_every_remaining_anchor_passes verifies a retired ID is named with removal guidance and that checking leaves its output in place until the test explicitly removes it. checking_is_read_only_and_recording_preserves_obsolete_records proves checking without records creates no validation directory and accepted/failing checks preserve record bytes; even later recording of another current anchor does not prune the obsolete record.

The tests directly exercise the advertised diagnostic categories through both CLI and library errors, and source inspection establishes exhaustive iteration and the shared Cargo display path. They do not imply an automated review was performed in response to an error. Fixture helpers construct isolated real claim/model/source workspaces and invoke production APIs or the check binary; assertions are present in the test bodies. No source changes or unresolved defect were identified.

This pass executed review start/read/record and source inspection only. No behavioral suites or failing Cargo invocation were rerun, consistent with central-suite coordination; test assertions are inspected evidence rather than newly observed executions. Dependency capture is complete for this assessment. No requested edits.
